name: kbd
title: Kbd
summary: Shows a keyboard key or shortcut, such as ⌘ K.
description: Keyboard hint: one or more keys, as in "⌘ K". boxed draws each key as a small raised key (docs, palettes, empty states); plain is text in the surrounding colour (tooltips, menu rows).

anatomy.description: The whole shortcut. Nested <kbd> keys are how HTML marks up a key combination. dir="ltr": the keys keep their reading order on a right-to-left page (⌘ then K), as printed on the keyboard.
One key or one run of keys ("⌘", "K", "Ctrl+K").

keys.description: The keys in order; each becomes one key part.

variant.description: boxed: 18px key, radius.chip, surface with shadow.btn, mono 11px ink-2. plain: 11px text in the inherited font and colour.

notes: Pair the hint with aria-keyshortcuts on the control it belongs to; the hint is for sight.
Write symbols the platform shows (⌘ on Apple, Ctrl elsewhere); screen readers read the characters.
